units.source_text: 群花盛开之时，薰中纳言遥望二条院中的樱花，首先想起无主的宇治山庄，独自吟唱“任意落风前”的古歌。

en.t: When flowers were in full bloom, Counselor Kaoru gazed from afar at the cherry blossoms in the Nijo estate, first thought of the masterless mountain villa at Uji, and quietly sang an old poem about petals falling freely before the wind.

units.source_text: 意犹未足，便到二条院来访问匂亲王。

en.t: Still not satisfied, he went to the Nijo estate to visit Prince Niou.

units.source_text: 匂亲王近来常住在这里，和二女公子相处十分亲睦。

en.t: Prince Niou had lately been staying there often, and he was living on very affectionate terms with the Second Princess.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言看了，觉得“这才像个样子”。

en.t: Seeing this, Counselor Kaoru felt that this was how things ought to be.

units.source_text: 然而不知何故，照例带有不快之感，却也奇怪。

en.t: Yet, for some reason he could not explain, he felt the usual trace of displeasure, which seemed strange even to him.

units.source_text: 虽然如此，他却真心地深为二女公子得所而庆幸。

en.t: Even so, he was sincerely and deeply glad that the Second Princess had found a fitting place for herself.

units.source_text: 匂亲王与薰君两人亲切地谈东说西。

en.t: Prince Niou and Lord Kaoru talked warmly together about all sorts of things.

units.source_text: 到了傍晚，匂亲王要进宫去，叫人装备车辆，许多随从人员聚拢来。

en.t: When evening came, Prince Niou prepared to go to the palace, had his carriage made ready, and many attendants gathered around.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言便离开匂亲王，走到二女公子住处去。

en.t: Counselor Kaoru then left Prince Niou and went over to the Second Princess's residence.
